conflicts.description: DOC-002's load drawing connects relay 16 to top-playfield GI (13 clear plus 13 red bulbs) and relay 26 to bottom-playfield GI (12 bulbs). Another 2-4 coin-door bulbs tap the shared F21 supply before the relay-26 contact; those unswitched cabinet lamps are supply context, not a controlled relay load. The same manual's coil table labels 16 FIELD RELAY BOT and 26 FIELD RELAY TOP; the observed R03 service labels and retained VPX LowerGILights/UpperGILights assignments agree with that table. The public trace confirms addresses and labels, not the physical region or wired bulb grouping. This is an unresolved difference a recreation consumes; neither region nor per-address quantity is promoted. Resolution path: an original-machine wired socket survey, or a physical-machine service video showing selectors 16/26 together with every bulb they illuminate, supplied by an owner or technician, must link each public address to its actual controlled playfield branch.

read_by.verification: Curators independently checked native source and root controls; rounded flipper heel centers estimate pivots, uncertainty15px; bumper circle centers uncertainty10px. Independent reader controls were rejected: left_pop540,490 is a circle on an upper assembly; the four replacement controls come from independent root source-only crops, not transformed VPX coordinates. Lamps39/40 are excluded because the same bumper circles anchor the control fit. All read marks were inspected on the native-page overlay. Printed-number reads beside parts remain approximate diagram locations, not surveyed socket centers; their original ambiguity is preserved. Rounded flipper heels are accepted as estimated pivot centers with 15px uncertainty, not explicit shaft dots.

drawing_callouts.rule: A placement is validated when its own callout on the factory location drawing (each callout paired with at most one placement of its label, nearest first) lands within 0.07 normalized of it under two least-squares fits of that page: one on independently read controls (jet-bumper caps and flipper pivots, or another crisp mechanism feature where balloons hide a pivot), and one, measured leave-one-out, on the page's other callout reads, from which any read beyond the limit is dropped. Placements without such a read keep their table status. Placements measured on a drawing are never checked against it.
